note: Only derivations listed under approved are allowed; every other request for a derived value is refused. Approved by the owner on 2026-11-06 (Task 13 question Q-1): the sum of the three measured power channels, attributed to Racks 1-6 as a group. No rack-level temperature aggregate and no per-rack power split is approved.

approved.formula_text: P_total = Power Ch 1 + Power Ch 2 + Power Ch 3, in W, at the same source timestamp. Defined only when all three inputs are observed with quality ok at that timestamp; otherwise the derived value is absent, never a partial sum. Attributed to Racks 1-6 as a group; never divided per rack.
